implemented_requirements.requirement: Player ship positioned at the bottom and can move horizontally
implemented_requirements.evidence: ship.py: reset_position() sets rect.midbottom to (screen_width//2, screen_height-10); update() moves rect.x left/right when moving_left/right flags are set. Game._check_keydown_events and _check_keyup_events toggle these flags.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player can fire shots with a cooldown and bullet limit
implemented_requirements.evidence: ship.py: fire() creates a Bullet with direction -1; can_fire() checks cooldown. Game._fire_bullet() checks can_fire() and len(self.player_bullets) < settings.max_player_bullets before appending.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Multiple alien rows descend and bounce at screen edges
implemented_requirements.evidence: settings.py: alien_rows = 4, alien_columns = 8. game.py: _create_fleet() creates Alien instances for each row/col. _update_aliens() moves aliens horizontally and drops them (drop = settings.fleet_drop_distance) when _fleet_hits_edge() is true.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends if any alien reaches the bottom of the screen
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py: _check_game_end() iterates over self.aliens and sets game_active = False when alien.rect.bottom >= self.ship.rect.top.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends with victory when all aliens are destroyed
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py: _check_game_end() sets game_active = False and game_won = True when not self.aliens.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Limited number of lives for the player
implemented_requirements.evidence: settings.py: starting_lives = 3. GameStats tracks lives_left. Game._lose_life() decrements lives_left and ends the game when it reaches 0.
game.py: when a player bullet collides with an alien, stats.score += alien.points and stats.aliens_left is decremented.

implemented_requirements.requirement: HUD displaying score, high score, remaining aliens and lives
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.py: _draw_hud() renders score, high score, aliens left and draws life icons for each remaining life.

critical_issues: In Game._check_collisions, if an alien collides with the ship, _lose_life() may be called multiple times in the same frame because the loop does not break after the first collision.
judge.summary: The provided code implements a functional Space Invaders clone with player ship movement, shooting, multiple alien rows that descend, win/lose conditions, limited lives, and score tracking. All core requirements are present and the game should run (pygame is auto‑installed if missing). Minor logic issue in collision handling does not prevent the main features from working.
